ask.1d: 1D reads the design as text: pick what to describe, get the matching requirements, basic design or detailed design document.
ask.2d: 2D is a flat drawing of the same parts and connections: buildings, floors, rooms, cards and lines.
ask.3d: 3D shows the same parts as a spatial scene.
ask.4d: 4D plays one authored case step by step.
ask.5d: 5D compares a case with and without one change and shows the chain of causes.
ask.qa: QA shows what the page contains and what still needs attention.
